facility.name: Kids World
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Skill Classes,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: Documentation of the safety drills for the home were copied from the previous year and included dates on Saturday and Sunday; in which the home is not open for childcare. No was no record of any severe weather of lockdown drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: At the time of inspection, the provider's CPR/First aid certification had expired on 2/3/26. A training class had been scheduled for this upcoming Saturday, 9/19.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Upon review, one child's admission form had a note written indicating that the child is not immunized, but no immunization exemption form was on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules: During the inspection time the provider was not aware of the minimum standards for a Licensed Child Care Home and didn't have a copy available in the home for review.   A copy of the minimum standards was emailed over to the provider during the inspection time and the inspector reviewed standards with the provider during this time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules (26 TAC §747.207(9))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: During the inspection time children in care were observed not washing their hands prior to sitting down and eating snacks provided by the primary caregiver. The provider was made aware of this concern and the children were instructed to go nad wash their hands with running water and soap before finishing up their snacks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §747.3213(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster: At the time of inspection the Keeping Child Care and list of employees were not posted in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster (26 TAC §747.401(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: At the time of inspection the provider only had 26 clock hours of training from the previous full year available for review. The provider advised that they were lacking 4 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: At the time of inspection, three children did not the required health statement on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records- Photo Identification: Photo identification was missing from the director's file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §747.901(8))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Telephone Numbers: Required phone numbers were not posted in the operation and accessible to view by parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §747.401(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-List of Employees: The list of employees was not posted in the operation and accessible to view by parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-List of Employees (26 TAC §747.401(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The previous inspection report was not posted in the operation and accessible to view by parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-License: The operation license was not posted in the operation and accessible to view by parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-License (26 TAC §747.401(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: The operation did not have written activity plans for the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster: The keeping children safe notice was not posted in the operation and accessible to view by parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster (26 TAC §747.401(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: This standard was found to be deficient as the living room and play room outlets did not have safety covers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: This standard was found to be deficient as the home lacked documentation of fire drills for the past two months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: This section was found to be deficient due to an incomplete section of the medical authorization information for one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: The provider's CPR/First Aid certification has expired as of 4/3/23. No training class had been scheduled at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: At the time of inspection two children did not have the required vision and hearing screenings on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §747.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The provider did not have documentation available to account for the required 30 hours of annual training on file for review at the time inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: At the time of inspection it was determined that the home's last fire inspection was conducted in January 2023. The home's last severe weather and lock down drill was also in January 2023. There was no other documentation available to indicate that additional drills had been performed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: At the time of inspection two children did not have the required health statement on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The operation could not provide documentation of the last safety drills preformed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Five children admission information did not list the address of th emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Two children admissionn information did not have the emergency medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The opertional policies did not list procedures for promoting physical activities for both indoors and outdoors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: Four children admission information did not list the release informtion for the contact persons.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §747.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
